concept_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: standalone application icon design concept for RAZE, a native Windows utility that removes stubborn files and folders. A refined bold monochrome geometric brand mark in the same visual family as minimal tech logos. Square image, single pure white symbol centered on a perfectly flat near-black #0B0B0E full canvas used ONLY as the presentation background. The icon itself is a freestanding mark, no enclosing tile or backing plate. Symbol takes approximately 58% of the canvas. Strong compact silhouette legible at 24px. Production vector-like finish: immaculate solid fills, smooth exact contours, clean negative space. No typography, no RAZE wordmark, no labels, numbers or watermark. No broom, trash can, folder, skull, game mascot, lightning bolt, gradient, glow, texture, shadows, 3D or rounded app tile.
Design 03: Abstract eraser made into a premium angular logo. A single thick oblique parallelogram leans 35 degrees, with one clipped lower corner. A bold negative-space diagonal incision divides the parallelogram into a larger upper block and a smaller lower block with clean offset edges. One subtly curved outside corner adds character. It should resemble a powerful cut or erasing stroke through its geometry alone, not a drawing of a stationery object. Compact approximately square silhouette, solid masses, broad incision, no fine outline, no ground line and no debris.
transparent_prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: final transparent Windows application icon for RAZE.
Edit target: supplied chosen concept 03, the two solid oblique white eraser/cut blocks separated by a bold rising diagonal gap.
Remove only the dark presentation background and replace it with genuine transparent alpha. Preserve the exact original selected icon geometry, proportions, orientation, two pieces, clipped lower-left corner, subtle rounded upper-left and lower-right corners, and broad diagonal gap. The dark area in the diagonal gap and outside the mark must become transparent.
Polish the symbol to perfectly solid pure white #FFFFFF fills with mathematically smooth crisp antialiased contours, no grain, stray flecks or textures. Add a slim dark charcoal #24262B outline around each of the TWO pieces, including along the diagonal gap, approximately 1% of total mark width. The white symbol must stay visually dominant. This outline lets the same white mark remain visible on light wallpaper; do not add any enclosing background or tile. Keep adequate separation between the pieces, do not let their outlines touch.
Output one square PNG with true transparency. Mark centered with its longest extent around 72% of canvas and ample transparent margin on all sides. No wordmark, no RAZE text, no letters, caption, numbering, watermark, shadow, gradient, glow, border around the canvas or checkerboard painted into the image. ONLY the preserved two-piece white mark with slim charcoal contours on real transparent alpha.
final_refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: RAZE transparent Windows icon optimized for visibility on white backgrounds.
Edit target: supplied transparent white two-piece eraser/cut mark.
Change ONE thing: strengthen the existing charcoal outline. Keep the selected two-piece geometry, orientation, proportions, corners, placement, white fill and transparent background unchanged.
The current contour is far too thin to see at 16px. Replace it with a continuous solid charcoal #24262B outline whose width is approximately 4% of the complete mark's width (roughly 35–40 pixels for a 1000px-wide symbol). It must be a visibly bold clean contour, not a hairline. Apply the outline inside the edges of BOTH pieces, including the diagonal gap, so the outside silhouette and the diagonal clear space retain their original geometry. Preserve ample pure white interior on both pieces. Dark strokes must not touch across the gap. Exact selected icon should remain immediately recognizable.
Flat white and flat dark fills, crisp smooth antialiased contours, no grain, texture, flecks, glow, shadow, bevel or gradient. Remove any stray semi-transparent pixels outside the two intended silhouettes.
Output true transparent alpha PNG. All space outside the two outlined pieces and the diagonal gap are genuinely transparent. No background tile, canvas border, caption, text, checkerboard or presentation backdrop. The ONLY visible content is the two-piece white mark with strengthened charcoal outlines.
